From Wearable to Coordinator Decision

Architecture & Pipeline in 6 Steps

01
Consumer Wearable

Apple Watch, Garmin, Fitbit. Hardware-agnostic telemetry from the client's existing device.

02
Companion Cloud Sync

Device syncs steps, sleep, resting HR, night wakings, and HRV to vendor cloud.

03
Standardized Integration API

HL7 FHIR R4 normalisation pipeline converts heterogeneous data into standard daily observations.

04
Everwell EU Hosting (GDPR Art. 9/17)

Data stored strictly in EU jurisdiction with cryptographic consent tokens and right to erasure.

05
28-Day Baseline Engine

1.2×IQR envelope, z-score, EWMA drift detection. Compares against personal history, not generic norms.

06
Care Coordinator Decision Support

Ranked list helps coordinators decide whom to visit first. Reduces unneeded visits, catches silent declines.

The Human Always Decides

Everwell is a non-diagnostic workflow prioritisation tool under MDCG 2019-11. It does not replace clinical judgment, diagnose disease, or autonomously dispatch emergency services.
